title: 第7章 战武者第8章 斩杀武者
content_zh:
“笑他妈什么！真是烦人，赶紧弄死！”
崔肖听到对方的笑声，非常厌烦。
一名手下收到命令，干脆地持刀走了过去，准备送这少年上路。
寒芒闪烁，没人再理会这个少年，准备去收割成熟的稻谷。
“噗~”
利刃切肉的声音。
“就这么走了，怎么对得起我那么死去的爹娘？”
稚嫩但冰冷的声音突然响起，正准备离开的崔肖猛地回头。
看到后面的景象，瞳孔突然一缩。
倒下的不是少年，而是自己的亲兵！
虽然亲兵不如自己，但那也是从战场上活下来的好手。
居然被少年夺了兵刃砍死了！
刚才发生了什么？
如果说对方是个大人，那还情有可原，但此人只是个十四五岁的少年。
愤怒在江平安心中疯狂喷涌。
父母劳累缴税，就是为了平平安安，就是为了生命无忧！
但是，他们的辛苦劳作，换来的却是压迫与死亡。
他之前还天真地想着，坏人是少数，很多人还都是好的。
直至见到今天的画面，他心中的幻想全部消失。
以后绝不根据对方身份，判断一个人的好坏。

江平安手持军刀，主动出击，向着崔肖冲去。
今天，他要发泄自己的愤怒，要用鲜血来祭奠父母和村民逝去的生命！
“不自量力。”
崔肖看着冲来的少年，脸上浮现出不屑的笑容。
他堂堂初级中队长，堪比练气三层。
别说是一个少年，就算是一百名普通士兵也别想对他造成威胁。
抽刀随意挥动，准备解决这个白痴少年。
就在江平安冲到崔肖面前的瞬间，速度突然暴涨，高高跃起。
刚才他只是以一个孩子的奔跑速度冲过来的，为的就是麻痹对方。
这一刻才是真正的杀机！
崔肖不愧是久经沙场的士兵，就在那短短的一瞬间，手里的刀迅速格挡。
“叮当~”
江平安的刀断了。
两人的刀完全不在一个级别，崔肖的刀明显要更好。
不过，断裂的刀刃极速划过崔肖的面庞，留下一道血痕。
江平安挥舞着断刀，向着对方脖子砍去。
崔肖脸色一变，快速滚下马。
可惜了这匹火红战马，江平安的刀划过，巨大的马头掉落在地上，鲜血染红地面。
旁边的士兵都惊呆了，这少年的力量怎么如此之大！一刀砍断了马头！
崔肖后背被冷汗浸湿，疯狂爆退，“你不是普通人！！”
content_en:
"What the hell are you laughing at! It's so annoying, kill him immediately!"
Cui Xiao was very annoyed when he heard the other party's laughter.
One of the men received the order and simply walked over with a knife, preparing to send the young man on his way.
The cold light flickered, and no one paid any attention to the young man, preparing to harvest the ripe rice.
"Pfft~"
The sound of a sharp knife cutting meat.
"Just leaving like this, how can I be worthy of my parents who are so dead?"
A childish but cold voice suddenly sounded, and Cui Xiao, who was about to leave, turned around suddenly.
Seeing the scene behind him, his pupils suddenly shrank.
It was not the boy who fell, but his own soldier!
Although the personal soldiers are not as good as themselves, they are still good at surviving the battlefield.
The young man actually took the weapon and hacked him to death!
What just happened?
If the other party was an adult, it would be excusable, but this person is just a boy of fourteen or fifteen years old.
Anger surged wildly in Jiang Ping'an's heart.
Parents work hard and pay taxes just for peace and a worry-free life!
However, their hard work was rewarded with oppression and death.
He had naively thought before that there were only a few bad people and many people were good.
Until he saw today's scene, all the illusions in his heart disappeared.
In the future, I will never judge a person's quality based on his or her identity.
Jiang Ping'an held a saber and took the initiative to attack Cui Xiao.
Today, he wants to vent his anger and use blood to pay homage to the lost lives of his parents and villagers!
“Don’t overestimate your own capabilities.”
Cui Xiao looked at the charging young man with a disdainful smile on his face.
He is a dignified junior squadron leader, comparable to the third level of Qi training.
Not to mention a young man, not even a hundred ordinary soldiers could threaten him.
He swung his knife around casually, ready to kill this idiot boy.
The moment Jiang Ping'an rushed in front of Cui Xiao, his speed suddenly increased and he jumped high into the air.
Just now, he just rushed over at the running speed of a child in order to paralyze the opponent.
This moment is the real killing opportunity!
Cui Xiao was worthy of being a battle-hardened soldier. In that short moment, he quickly blocked the attack with the knife in his hand.
"Ding Dong~"
Jiang Ping'an's knife was broken.
Their swords are not at the same level at all, Cui Xiao's sword is obviously better.
However, the broken blade cut across Cui Xiao's face very quickly, leaving a trail of blood.
Jiang Ping'an waved the broken knife and slashed at the opponent's neck.
Cui Xiao's expression changed and he quickly got off the horse.
It was a pity for this fiery red war horse. Jiang Ping'an's knife slashed across it, and the huge horse head fell to the ground, staining the ground red with blood.
The soldiers next to him were shocked, how could this young man be so powerful! Cut off the horse's head with one knife!
Cui Xiao's back was soaked with cold sweat and he retreated crazily, "You are not an ordinary person!!"
